title: cloud: the connector-app shelf pipeline — ingest the open-edition connector-app packages built in objectstack, generate their marketplace listings with provenance, and run the normalization script from an objectstack checkout
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ④ coordination child of #27293 (E4), the cloud-repository half the ruling of #27302 assigns. Ruling-ref: 6486157794 (letter A, phased): "Ingestion and listing generation stay with the cloud repository as #27293 assigns them … plus the pipeline card in the cloud repository." Filed here as the `repo:cloud` carrier because this seat's session cannot reach `objectstack-ai/cloud`; the cloud seat moves it or files its own and closes this one as moved. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the cloud side receives from objectstack

- Open-edition connector-app packages, one per vendor, built and validated in this repository: batch 1 #28276 (GitHub over MCP, Stripe read over OpenAPI), batch 2 #28277 (DocuSign, after #26702).
- The offline normalizer `packages/connectors/connector-openapi/scripts/normalize-openapi.mts` (PR #27436, merged): a repository script, **not** shipped in the npm package (`files` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`), so the pipeline runs it from an `objectstack` checkout (`pnpm install`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-openapi normalize-openapi`). Whether the pipeline can do that is the first thing to measure here; if it cannot, say so on #27293 and the epic PM brings the "publish it as a bin" option to the maintainer (that widens a published surface).
- The listing file and README conventions: `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`.

## What is asked

Ingest the packages, publish their listings through the marketplace review flow, and carry provenance (upstream, commit, sha256 the normalizer prints) on each listing — #27293's Done-when.

## Reader

The cloud seat (`repo:cloud`), first touch in the cloud repository. Not needed before #28276 has a merged package.

## Dedupe

The 500 most recent issues and PRs in this repository (read 2026-10-31T02:05Z), titles grepped for `connector app|shelf|docusign|stripe|github mcp|E4`: 0 hits; control `connector` 47. The cloud repository was not searched (not reachable from this session).
